title: 第9章 黑夜骑士第10章 我来助你
slug: 老师是个多周目速通玩家
lines: 从南方离开迷魅森林的路有且只有一条。
只因为南侧横着一条水流湍急的大河，跨河的方式只有一种，那就是东南角方向的那座古石桥。
常规游戏推进线路来到这个位置就开始显露出对玩家的恶意了。
辛之墓群阶段还只是开胃小菜，因为严格来说在那里珲伍完全可以避免任何战斗（没有出bug的情况下）。
而离开迷魅森林的这座石桥上，必定会刷新一个各方面数值都远超当前角色属性的精英怪。
黑夜骑士。
一种类似于幽魂的存在，当代学术界将其定义为某些古老意志残存的痕迹。
这种骑着黑色战马、披着斗篷手持长戟的无脸生灵，是某一位古老邪灵的追随者，邪灵可能已经不复存在了，但它一定程度上还在对法则和秩序施加特殊影响，于是就有了这些游荡在世界各地角落的黑夜骑士。
讲直白点就是工厂倒闭了但流水线的工人还在按时打卡。
黑夜骑士有个特点，那就是它只在夜晚刷新，而且只在某一固定区域巡逻。
而迷魅森林的特点就是，这里永远都是夜晚。
也不知道这是不是传说中那位邪神的设定，反正古石桥上的黑夜骑士就这么007全年无休地一直巡逻着。
下班？不存在的。
迷魅森林的东西两侧分别是断崖和高山，南边只有这一条路，必然会撞上黑夜骑士，所以理论上来说，北面才是正路。
但就如游魂商人所说，北方是沼泽地，呆在那个鬼地方的每一分每一秒都在持续掉血，除非愿意花重金从商人手中购买足量的解毒苔药，否则就是神仙蹚过那个粪坑都得脱一层皮。
当然，速通路线必然是走南边，砍死黑夜骑士也就顺手的事。
可珲伍现在并不是在打速通。
而且黑夜骑士不比辛之墓群的妖鬼王，它有着非常特殊的设定……
它会回血。
只要沐浴在黑暗环境下，它就可以持续回血。
弄死它的方式只有一种——把它秒了。
36级的珲伍显然不具备这样的数值。
但他还是毅然决然地选择往南走。
宁语不明所以，但她还是默默地跟了上去。
直到在远远的看到远方石桥上游荡的黑夜骑士的阴影时，她的脸色终于变了。
然而珲伍的步伐未停，依旧直勾勾地朝着古石桥的方向走去。
宁语顿时陷入了挣扎。
她可太清楚黑夜骑士是怎样一种存在了。
整个南方国度里，最令人闻风丧胆的夜间生灵就是黑夜骑士，它们的威名甚至超过了该隐赫斯特城堡的血族。
因为，血族再如何凶残，毕竟是有可能被杀死的，而黑夜骑士则很难，如果做不到一击必杀，那它们就会像狗皮膏药一样追杀你，直至天明，如果你能侥幸活到天亮，那么第二天夜晚，满血的黑夜骑士又会再度找上门来…
且它们的战斗力普遍高得骇人。
有多高？
曾经她们宁家就有人惹上过黑夜骑士，那一次宁家的高手是倾巢而出，才终止了黑夜骑士对族人的追杀，并且据说当时还没能彻底灭杀那个骑士，只是利用一些特殊手法转移了它的仇恨值而已…
在那之后，宁家对家族内部子嗣的教育中就增加了与黑夜骑士相关的这一则——千万千万不要去惹那种脏东西。
所以即便宁语从来没有亲眼见过黑夜骑士，但良好的家族启蒙教育还是让她第一时间认清了远方古石桥上那道极具压迫感的阴影的身份。
这东西并不一定有妖鬼王那么强大的杀伤力，但设定上过于难杀了。
你打不过妖鬼王，可以逃出地下世界。
可你惹上了黑夜骑士，难道你还能逃得过夜晚吗？
然而就是这么个致命的狗皮膏药，珲伍义无反顾地a了上去。
content_en:
There is only one way out of the Enchanted Forest from the south.
Just because there is a fast-flowing river running across the south side, there is only one way to cross the river, and that is the ancient stone bridge in the southeast corner.
When the conventional game advancement line reaches this point, it begins to show its malice toward players.
The Tomb of Xin stage is just an appetizer, because strictly speaking, Hunwu can avoid any combat there (as long as there are no bugs).
On the stone bridge leaving the Enchanted Forest, there will definitely be an elite monster with values ​​far exceeding the current character's attributes in all aspects.
Night Knight.
A ghost-like existence, which contemporary academic circles define as the remaining traces of some ancient will.
This faceless creature riding a black horse, wearing a cloak and holding a halberd, is a follower of an ancient evil spirit. The evil spirit may no longer exist, but it still exerts a special influence on law and order to a certain extent, so there are these night knights wandering around the world.
To put it bluntly, the factory has closed down but the workers on the assembly line are still clocking in on time.
One characteristic of the Night Knight is that it only refreshes at night and only patrols a certain fixed area.
The characteristic of the Enchanted Forest is that it is always night here.
I don’t know if this is the setting of the legendary evil god, but the night knight on the ancient stone bridge is patrolling like this 007 all year round.
get off work? Doesn't exist.
The east and west sides of the Enchanted Forest are cliffs and mountains respectively. There is only one road to the south, and you will inevitably hit the Night Knight, so in theory, the north is the right way.
But as the Wandering Soul Merchant said, the north is a swamp, and you will continue to lose blood every minute and every second you stay in that ghost place. Unless you are willing to spend a lot of money to buy a sufficient amount of detoxifying moss from the merchant, even a god will have to shed a layer of skin when he walks into that cesspit.
Of course, the speed route must be to the south, and it would be easy to kill the Night Knight.
Ke Huiwu is not speedrunning now.
And the Night Knight is no better than the Demon King of the Tombs of Xin, it has a very special setting...
It will return blood.
As long as it is bathed in a dark environment, it can continue to regenerate blood.
There's only one way to kill it - kill it.
Level 36 Hui Wu obviously does not have such values.
But he still decided to go south.
Ning Yu didn't know why, but she followed him silently.
It wasn't until she saw the shadow of the Night Knight wandering on the stone bridge in the distance that her expression finally changed.
However, Hui Wu's steps did not stop, and he still walked straight towards the ancient stone bridge.
Ning Yu suddenly fell into struggle.
She knew very well what kind of existence the Dark Knight was.
In the entire southern kingdom, the most feared night creatures are the night knights, and their reputation even exceeds that of the vampires in Cainhurst Castle.
Because, no matter how ferocious the vampires are, they can still be killed, but it is very difficult for the Night Knights. If they cannot kill you with one hit, they will hunt you down like a dog-skin plaster until dawn. If you are lucky enough to survive until dawn, then the full-blooded Night Knights will come to you again the next night...
And their combat effectiveness is generally frighteningly high.
How high?
Someone from the Ning family once provoked the Night Knight. That time, the Ning family's masters came out in full force to end the Night Knight's pursuit of the clan members. It is said that they were not able to completely kill the knight at that time, but only used some special techniques to transfer its hatred value...
After that, the Ning family added this lesson related to the Dark Night Knight to the education they gave to their heirs - never mess with that kind of dirty thing.
So even though Ning Yu had never seen the Night Knight with her own eyes, the good family education allowed her to immediately recognize the identity of the oppressive shadow on the ancient stone bridge in the distance.
This thing may not be as lethal as the Demon King, but the setting is too difficult to kill.
You can't defeat the Demon King, but you can escape from the underground world.
But you have offended the Night Knight, can you still escape the night?
However, it was such a fatal plaster, and Hui Wu applied it without hesitation.
title_en: Chapter 9 Night Knight Chapter 10 I'm here to help you
